name: io.github.kurok/whoopmcp
description: Read-only MCP server for the WHOOP API v2 -- recovery, sleep, strain, workouts

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID issued by WHOOP for your registered app.

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret issued by WHOOP for your registered app.

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: OAuth redirect URI registered with WHOOP. Must not use http://.
